musee.name: Le grand hall du musée · The museum's great hall
musee.alt: The great hall of the village museum, seen from the near left and slightly above: cream stone columns, a polished pale marble floor, a glass pyramid skylight, a grand staircase rising to an upper gallery balcony and a draped white statue wearing a tiny visitor badge. Up on the balcony a young woman in a yellow dress waves a red scarf over the balustrade, and beside her a photographer in a green cardigan looks through a big old wooden bellows camera. On the left a tour guide in sunglasses and a blue blazer holds up a folded umbrella for his group, a white-haired granny with her hair in a bun and a pearl necklace points to her cabinet of colorful seashells, and a young cleaner in blue overalls vacuums the floor in front of a huge gilt-framed landscape masterpiece. In the middle an artist in a flowered smock stands at her easel holding a steaming cup of tea, and in front Monsieur Verbe in a red beret sits on a bench turning a big wooden hourglass, passing the time. On the right a jolly man dressed as a pirate raises his fist in delight at a framed painting, a gray cat sits beside a glass case holding a little model of the museum while a guard smiles at it, and a man in a tweed vest puffs past carrying a tall white obelisk. A yellow door with a crayon on the left wall leads to the art workshop, a dark green door at the back leads to the detective gallery, and a white door with a microscope sign on the right wall leads to the medicine gallery.

atelier.name: L'atelier des enfants · The children's workshop
atelier.alt: The museum's children's workshop on Saturday art club, seen from the near left: sunflower-yellow walls hung with children's paintings, paper ceiling lamps, low wooden tables with paint pots and crayons, a green play mat and a giant crayon used as a coat stand. At the back left a lady illustrator in glasses holds open a huge picture book with a blue whale, a girl with a black bob spins a round zoetrope drum with little galloping horses, and in the teddy hospital corner a girl tends a sick doll tucked into a toy bed with a thermometer and a hot-water bottle. In front a little girl in a toy nurse's apron sticks a bandage on her teddy bear, and a red-pigtailed girl holds up two batteries beside her stopped toy robot with its battery hatch open. On the right a boy holds up his crayon drawing of a sunny beach, another dips a fat paintbrush into a frying pan of blue paint, a boy kneeling on the mat paints a red flower on a sheet of white paper, and two boys carry a smiling rag doll with a bandaged knee and an arm sling on a little toy stretcher. A slate-blue door on the left leads back to the great hall.

doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the great hall

enquete.name: Les romans policiers · Detective stories
enquete.alt: The museum's detective-story gallery on its 'solve the mystery' family day, seen from the near left: bottle-green walls, brass picture lamps, red velvet ropes on brass posts and a giant deerstalker hat over the striped puppet booth. At the back left a cheerful lady in a black dress holds up a blue prize rosette behind the iron bars of the old prison-cell exhibit while her friend photographs her; at a café table two old ladies frown comically and tug the one teacup. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret plays the fairy-tale witch in the puppet booth, dipping a red apple into a bubbling green cauldron beside a hobby-horse pony and a girl in a witch hat. At the back right a waxwork gentleman-criminal in a top hat and mask holds a popsicle and a little bell, and a waxwork villain in a cloak stands empty-handed in a tall glass case with sand at his boots. In front a young woman in a red cape raises a lantern and magnifying glass, a giant striped party popper bursts confetti as a girl in yellow claps, a girl offers a cookie to a little white dog guarding a small white model of the Taj Mahal, and a detective in a deerstalker studies a red jewel cushion smeared with whipped cream. On the right a man in a Hawaiian shirt rushes the gift-shop postcard racks, a grinning masked burglar tiptoes off with a small painting and a fishing rod with a green lure, and a man in a bow tie clutches his hot cheeks beside a flame-red book on a lectern. Doors: slate-blue on the left back to the great hall, iron-studded oak at the back, plain gray at the back right.

armes.name: La salle d'armes · The armory hall
armes.alt: The museum's armory hall, seen from the near left: gray stone walls, iron chandeliers with white bulbs, a blue banner with a smiling golden lion and one unbroken red velvet rope on brass posts running in front of the displays; every weapon is an antique display object and nobody holds one. On the far left a life-size figure of Sir Lancelot in a blue tunic with a white cross stands on a stone plinth beside his tall striped jousting lance. On the back wall a big bronze arm sticks out of the stone, holding up an old mace, while a little girl points up at it; a ginger cat mews at the feet of an empty suit of armor, and a forester lady holds an ash sprig up to an old ax on a wall rack. In front a lady offers a candy from a paper bag beside a small glass case with a round black cartoon bomb, its fuse unlit, and a gray-haired lady hands a coin to a guard beside a long shining sword lying on a red velvet cushion. On the right an old gentleman points a yardstick at a jeweled dagger on a cushion, a guard dozes on a stool below an old rifle on wall pegs, a man in a green cardigan makes a peace sign by the small pistol case, a boy holds up a toy Noah's ark toward the longbow on the wall, and a potter holds up a little clay shield beside a big round painted shield. Door: bottle-green on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery.

medecine.name: La galerie de la médecine · The history-of-medicine gallery
medecine.alt: The museum's history-of-medicine gallery, seen from the near left: white and pale teal tiles, honey-wood apothecary cabinets, milk-glass ceiling globes and glass cases. At the back left a scientist peers into a giant brass microscope while her white-haired father in a white coat chats with a friend; a nurse in an old-fashioned cap holds up a giant plain white tube by a sanatorium chair with a plaid blanket; in front a girl in a lab coat sprays a giant green plush germ. In the middle a girl with an ice-cream cone yawns and her two friends yawn too, a farm lady in a headscarf shows an empty wooden bowl beside an empty grain bin of dry wheat stalks, and at the back a girl pours more tea beside a big hourglass whose sand has all run out. In the center a mischievous long-nosed Pinocchio puppet stands in a glass case, and a cheerful boy on a bench reads a small gray blood-sugar meter beside a bowl of sugar cubes. On the right a Victorian doctor in a top hat and big white collar grips the curved iron pipe of an old black water pump, a boy lifts a giant red blood-cell model over his head, a bearded man in a white coat shows a red crab in a case under a star chart, and a boy walks his collie on a red lead past a case holding an empty old bottle and a glass of water. Doors: slate-blue on the left wall, back to the museum hall; plain gray at the back right, to the health wall-text room.

mots_delits.name: Le couloir des mots (1) · Word corridor 1 (text only)
mots_delits.alt: A quiet, plain word corridor of the museum seen straight down its length: pale gray walls, pale oak floor and three round milk-glass lamps. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights along both walls, five on the left and eight on the right; two low wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A potted fern stands on a bench against the back wall. Doors: plain gray on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery; plain gray at the back, to the storybook courtroom.

mots_deuil.name: Le couloir des mots (2) · Word corridor 2 (text only)
mots_deuil.alt: The quiet second room of the museum word corridor, softly lit by a round skylight: pale gray walls with a dark-blue baseboard and a pale oak plank floor. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights: two on the left wall, four in a zigzag on the back wall and seven along the right wall; two wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A wooden bench stands under the back wall and a potted olive tree in the back right corner. Door: plain gray on the left wall, back to the old hospital ward.

tribunal.name: Le tribunal des romans · The storybook courtroom
tribunal.alt: A museum's reconstructed old courtroom on a family mock-trial day, dark wood paneling and a green-and-cream tiled floor under brass lamps. A smiling white-haired judge sits at the raised bench at the back. In the jury box at the back left a lady juror in a feathered hat wags her finger at a startled lawyer in a white wig. On a bench a cartoon criminal in a striped shirt and eye mask sips tea from a tin mug, and in the left foreground a big hairy brute looks sheepish over a china teapot and a smashed cup. In the middle a grinning jailbird signs a paper with an enormous feather quill pen. On the right a mafioso in a pinstripe suit poses with a tennis racket, a stalk of celery in a black mask and striped shirt sits in the dock, and a masked burglar tiptoes off with a giant wedge of brie. A small antique revolver lies on a turning stand in a glass case at the right, and three spectators on the upper balcony peer through opera glasses. Doors: plain gray on the left wall, back to the word corridor; red wood with a ship lantern at the back right, to the harbor tavern.

taverne.name: La taverne du port · The harbor tavern
taverne.alt: A museum's life-size reconstructed harbor tavern with timber beams, whitewashed walls, fishing nets, a ship's wheel and hanging ship lanterns; pewter mugs stand untouched on a shelf behind the bar and nobody is drinking. By the red door on the left a laughing young woman gives her grinning boyfriend a playful cartoon slap, little stars bursting, while he holds a bunch of flowers. In front of them a comic dust cloud of a scuffle rolls around a big duffel bag, a laughing sailor in a red bandana in the middle of it, nobody hurt. On a table two little cartoon bulls in red boxing gloves spar on a giant apple core. In the middle a tipsy rosy-nosed sailor dances with a potted fir tree, and at the bar a tipsy old fisherman dozes with his nose in his soup. In front, a red-nosed old cook weeps as he peels a big sack of onions. On the right a white-bearded old man with a cold, unlit pipe in his teeth holds a brass tuba; there is no smoke. Doors: red wood on the left wall, back to the courtroom; an open archway at the back right with a gangway up to the pirate ship.

bateau_pirate.name: Le bateau pirate · The pirate ship
bateau_pirate.alt: The main deck of a life-size wooden pirate ship standing in the museum's glass-roofed ship hall on a family dress-up day; there are no swords or cannons. High in the crow's nest at the upper left a person in a giant carrot costume keeps a lookout with cupped hands. A laughing pirate holds up his boot with a brass compass stuck to the sole. At the front left two dress-up children gaze at a shiny red toy car on a stack of cargo crates and sacks, and a sailor kneels at an open deck hatch, calling down into the dark hold. In the middle a helmsman in a tricorn hat steers at the big wooden wheel, and a smiling mother in a headscarf hugs the tall mast. On the raised deck at the right a dashing privateer in a plumed hat points out ahead, and two mischievous bandits grin and wave from the ship's little barred brig. A pirate kid opens a loot sack full of giant colorful buttons, a girl blows soap bubbles out of a round brass porthole, and a little rat in a red bandana sits on a barrel holding one big green pea. Door: the open doorway at the top of the gangway on the left, back to the harbor tavern.

hospice.name: L'hospice d'autrefois · The old hospital ward
hospice.alt: A museum's reconstructed old hospital ward and bath-cure room with white tiled walls, tall windows and a pale tiled floor. At the back left a row of iron beds holds sniffly patients with thermometers and handkerchiefs while a nurse in a white cap brings a bowl of green pea soup. In front, a little girl on a stool holds a plush bunny whose cut tummy shows colorful play-dough stuffing, and a boy pulls back a white curtain to find a patch of wall oozing thick green goo. In the middle a happy mother sits on a green couch with her newborn baby beside a smiling mime in a red beret. On the right a big museum diorama shows a murky green river flowing down a hillside, carrying cartoon locusts on leaf rafts, and a man in an old striped bathing suit leaps out of a steamy steam room into an icy plunge pool. Doors: white with a round window at the left, back to the medicine gallery; plain gray at the back right, to the word corridor.
